tips.text: Run Abyssal Zone on Steel Path; it pays 8 to 12 Vainthorn instead of 6 to 8, so you need fewer runs and fewer beacons.
Join a recruiting-chat squad and rotate host so only one beacon burns per run.
Kill the Exterminate count first, then grab the nearest Defixio and carry it out; carrying it limits you to secondary and melee.
Pick the Defixio up, switch to your Operator, walk to extraction and switch back to dodge its curse.
Drop a Defixio with a nasty curse and take another with an easier one.
Carry only one Defixio per player; extras and rescued operatives pay nothing more.
Recruit a premade squad; the mission has no public matchmaking and launching alone puts you in solo.
Keep the host in the squad; if the host leaves, the run fails for everyone.
Pick up a Defixio before an Acolyte shows up on Steel Path; they can make uncollected ones vanish and stall the mission.
Bring a tough frame such as Inaros or Kullervo; the Exposure curse strips shields.
Use Loot Radar, Golden Instinct or manual waypoints to find Defixios faster.
Bank standing in two or three syndicates before you start; each has its own daily cap, so you can buy more beacons a day.
Expect easy but dull: a deterministic farm of the same Galleon Exterminate, with the beacon standing as the tax.
